abstract: Maintains ecological buffer validation and surface subsidence risk indices
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance lead (ENV), responsible for maintaining ecological buffer validation and surface subsidence risk indices across geothermal exploration sites, as well as managing topsoil restoration planning.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains ecological buffer validation and surface subsidence risk indices（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-J3S：For Thermal Ridge Sector, the biological impact assessment indicates that ecological buffer clearance is false, as the wellhead perimeter and access paths do not satisfy the statutory 500-meter minimum buffer from sensitive wildlife and riparian zones. Meanwhile, the InSAR baseline geodetic model measures a surface subsidence risk index of 3 points for the candidate reservoir overburden.
ENV-ECO-HZ7：At Pinnacle Fault Graben, the biological impact assessment confirms that ecological buffer clearance is true across the exploration wellhead perimeter and access paths, adhering to the 500-meter setback from sensitive habitats. Furthermore, the surface subsidence risk index assessed from the InSAR baseline geodetic model across the reservoir overburden is 4 points.
ENV-ECO-G83：For Solstice Caldera Basin, the biological impact assessment confirms that ecological buffer clearance is true across the exploration wellhead perimeter and access paths, satisfying the statutory 500-meter minimum buffer from sensitive wildlife and riparian zones. In addition, the InSAR baseline geodetic model for the reservoir overburden evaluates the surface subsidence risk index at 2 points on a 1-to-10 geotechnical susceptibility scale.

information_points.title: Topsoil restoration planning（REHAB）
information_points.content:
ENV-REHAB-B6E：According to the reclamation seed bank protocol for Pinnacle Fault Graben, the prescribed vegetation recovery seed density for post-drilling reseeding across the surface exploration footprint is 450 seeds/m^2.
ENV-REHAB-XRL：Under the reclamation seed bank protocol for Solstice Caldera Basin, the prescribed vegetation recovery seed density for post-drilling reseeding across the surface exploration footprint is 250 seeds/m^2.
ENV-REHAB-DI4：For Thermal Ridge Sector, the reclamation seed bank protocol specifies a vegetation recovery seed density of 350 seeds/m^2 across the surface exploration footprint for post-drilling topsoil restoration.
